title: Sunset Wizard Coleus - Mini Plug Plant - Interesting Red/Yellow Semi Succulent
description:
Coleus ‘Wizard Sunset’ – Mini Plug Plant
 

 A compact, tender perennial prized for its striking foliage. The velvety, apricot-red to rusty-orange leaves are edged with pale margins, creating dramatic colour in pots, borders, or as a houseplant. Part of the easy-to-grow
 
  Wizard
 
 series, this dwarf variety forms neat, bushy plants without the need for pinching out.


   Ultimate size:
  
  Around 20–40 cm tall, compact and bushy
 

   Habit:
  
  Tender, perennial foliage plant (often grown as an annual in cooler climates)
 

   Position:
  
  Sun or light shade; avoid very dry soil
 

   Soil:
  
  Moist, well-drained compost or garden soil
 

   Foliage colour:
  
  Orange-red with pale edges
 

   Care:
  
  Water regularly, keeping soil evenly moist; pinch flowers if desired to prolong leaf display
 

   Hardiness:
  
  Tender – protect from frost; suitable for indoor growing in cooler climates
 

   Propagation:
  
  Easy from seed or cuttings; sow at 20–25 °C in spring for best results
 

   Uses:
  
  Excellent for pots, containers, summer bedding, or as a striking houseplant
 

 A vibrant, low-maintenance foliage plant that brings a splash of colour indoors or outdoors through summer and beyond.
